name: jpswade/laravel-best-practices
description: Opinionated, additive Laravel best-practices overlay for Laravel Boost. Composes alongside Boost's built-in laravel-best-practices skill; covers ground Boost is silent on.

suggest.laravel/boost: Required for automatic discovery of the guidelines and skill in this package.
suggest.larastan/larastan: Required to use the recommended phpstan.neon.dist shipped with this package.
suggest.phpstan/phpstan-strict-rules: Required to use the recommended phpstan.neon.dist shipped with this package.
